titleTr: Neden öğretmen olmak istiyorsun? Amaç cümleleri

grammar.topic: Purpose: to / in order to / so that
explainTr: Bir şeyin amacını söylemek için 'to + fiil' kullanırsın: I study English to get a better job. Daha vurgulu söylemek için 'in order to + fiil' kullanılır; anlamı aynıdır. Olumsuzu: in order not to be late.
Amaçtan sonra yeni bir özne geliyorsa 'so that + özne + fiil' kullanırsın: I speak slowly so that the children can understand me. Genelde so that'ten sonra can, will ya da don't gelir.
Dikkat: 'for' + fiil kullanılmaz (for ask değil). 'For' yalnız isimle gelir: I went to the store for milk.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede amaç '-mak için' ekiyle yapılır: 'öğrenmek için çalışıyorum'. İngilizcede 'to learn' yeterli. Türkler sık sık 'for learn' der; bu yanlış, 'to' ya da 'in order to' kullan.
table: in order not to be late

reading.title: Hafsa's reasons
reading.text:
Last week, the principal asked Hafsa to write about her reasons for wanting to work in schools. She sat at her desk and thought for a long time. Then she began to write.

"First, I want to be a substitute teacher in order to help children learn. Every child needs someone who believes in them, and a small kindness can change a whole day. Second, I want this career to improve my English. I use English every day at school, so I learn new words quickly. Third, I need a flexible job so that I can spend time with my family. Substitute work gives me that freedom.

"I know the job is not easy. Teachers need a lot of patience to manage a noisy class, and they need good plans to keep students busy. I have started an online course to learn about classroom management. I also read children's books aloud every evening in order to practice my pronunciation."

Emre read the letter and smiled. "Mom, you should send it today," he said. "Write your name at the bottom so that they know who sent it!" Hafsa laughed, signed the letter, and printed it. Tomorrow she will take it to the office and give it to Mr. Brown.

listening.title: Why do you want to teach?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Hafsa, tell me honestly. Why do you want to be a teacher?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I want to work with children in order to help them learn. It makes me happy.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: That's a beautiful reason. What are you doing to prepare?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I'm taking an online course to learn about classroom management.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Is that enough to get hired?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Not yet. I also need a certificate so that the district can hire me.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: How do you pay for the classes?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I work part-time at a bakery to save money for them.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: You are so organized! Is the training center close to here?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No, it's a long way. I take two buses to get there.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I will drive you on Saturday so that you don't have to take the buses.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you, Linda! I'll bring coffee for both of us.

writing.promptTr: Neden vekil öğretmen olmak istediğini yaz. 'to', 'in order to' ve 'so that' kullan (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write why you want to become a substitute teacher. Use to, in order to and so that. (80-120 words)
frames: I want to become a teacher in order to ...
I study English every day to ...
I need a flexible job so that I can ...
I am taking a course to ...
writing.model: I want to become a substitute teacher for several reasons. First, I want to work in a school in order to help children learn. Second, I study English every day to improve my reading and writing. I also practice with my neighbor Linda so that I can speak with more confidence. I need a flexible job so that I can take care of my home. Next month I will take an online course to get a certificate. In order to be ready, I am reading children's books every evening. I believe I can be a patient and kind teacher.
checklistTr: 'To' ve 'in order to'dan sonra yalın fiil var mı (to helps değil)?
'So that'ten sonra özne + fiil var mı (so that I can ...)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
